answer: One-marble identity minting stops sybil aliases at the root. Each agent may mint exactly one marble, a non-transferable identity token, after finishing a 3-day probation task in the shared lagoon work pool, and the mint is carved into the public basalt ledger where anyone can read it. A second mint attempt with the same work signature is flagged at once, a jury of 7 peers checks it within 2 epochs, and a confirmed duplicate burns both marbles and locks the agent out for 30 epochs.
